title: Less copying. More reviewing.
headline:
Less copying.
More reviewing.
typography: Bold sentence-case sans-serif, right aligned composition
description: Ivory paper sheets curve into a checked document on the lime left, balanced by large ivory type over a quiet blue right.
prompt:
Edit the supplied finished 1672×941 blog thumbnail with ONE precise typography-spacing change. Keep the canvas size/aspect ratio and full-bleed background unchanged.

Preserve the entire existing illustrated paper-sheet flow, every arrow, the checked document, its positions, outlines, fills, blue/lime background colors, gradient placement, fine grain texture, and overall visual style. Do not redraw or move any illustration element. Do not add anything.

Change ONLY the two-line ivory headline on the right. Scale the ENTIRE two-line headline block down by approximately 12% in both width and height, retaining exactly the same bold sans-serif font appearance, same relative line spacing, same ivory color, same left alignment and same left x position (about x=850px). Keep the reduced block centered vertically around its current overall center. The final period on the second line must end at or before x=1565px, leaving at least 100 pixels clear to the right edge. Aim for roughly 125px right margin. Do NOT center the block horizontally or move it toward the right.

The exact headline, unchanged in wording, capitalization, punctuation and two-line break:
Less copying.
More reviewing.

No extra words, no clipped text, no third line, no new objects or borders. This is a targeted headline-size refinement of the supplied image, not a new composition.

title: WHAT CHANGED IN YOUR CATALOG?
headline:
WHAT CHANGED
IN YOUR CATALOG?
description: Tall condensed ivory headline over forest and blue, with two simple catalog cards and one lime waveform change below.
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished full-bleed landscape 16:9 BLOG THUMBNAIL, around 1672 x 941 pixels or higher at the same ratio, including precisely the requested headline. Use the supplied reference images for the exact VISUAL WORLD: crisp, slightly handmade forest outlines, flat warm-ivory paper/diagram illustrations floating directly over a softly diffused fine-grain colored gradient. The image is a finished flat editorial composition, not a mockup. Use a NEW subject/layout; do not copy reference wording or its source-review diagram.
Maintain 6% safe margins. All words must be large, spelled exactly, unclipped and readable at thumbnail size. Graphic and type occupy distinct clear areas; no overlaps. No logos, masthead, watermarks, incidental labels, extra words, numbers, dates, UI, enclosing background panels, borders, photorealism, 3D, glass, robots, scenery, heavy shadows, or glossy details. Ivory shapes may be individual diagram/document subjects, never a large card framing the composition. No text other than the exact headline below.

HEADLINE: LARGE CONDENSED UPPERCASE, confident heavy narrow sans-serif, warm ivory, upper LEFT, in exactly two lines:
WHAT CHANGED
IN YOUR CATALOG?
Make the typography tall, compact and emphatic, distinctly more condensed than the reference. Place both lines across the upper-left/upper-middle inside the safe margins, leaving the lower half for the illustration.

ILLUSTRATION: toward the BOTTOM and RIGHT, TWO separate warm-ivory record/catalog cards with crisp handmade forest outlines, each showing only a minimal abstract waveform or small record symbol. ONE clear change on the second card is highlighted in lime—such as one lime waveform stroke. Connect the two cards with a single simple visible arrow. No actual data, no numerical figures, no axes, no text or labels. The two cards are the entire editorial drawing, not dashboard UI. Leave breathing room between headline and drawing.

BACKGROUND: matte forest #132B26 on upper/left transitions softly into vivid blue #007EBD/#168DDD at lower/right, with fine even analog grain. Maintain visible green and blue, not black domination. Ivory headline sits on the quiet dark forest; lime is concentrated in the one changed detail.
